fullBackup.accountsWarning: Contains password hashes (and two-factor secrets): anyone holding the file can try to guess the passwords offline. Encrypt it, or uncheck this box before sending it to someone else. Login sessions are never included.
fullBackup.accountsLeftOut: Accounts left out: restoring this file keeps the accounts of the Meshloom it is restored on.

warnings.accounts_restored: The accounts were replaced by the ones in the backup and every session was signed out: sign in again with an account from the backup.
warnings.accounts_no_admin: The accounts in the backup were not restored: none is an enabled administrator. The current accounts were kept.
warnings.trusted_network_dropped: The trusted network {{value}} was removed: its account is not the same person in the restored accounts.
